title: Integrate recovery reconciler with Agent run state
purpose: Make crash recovery reconcile both scheduling state and effect truth without model replay.
scope: Extend recovery scan to join RunStore recoverable runs with AuditJournal unresolved effects.
Classify each run as safe-to-verify, needs-rollback, needs-human-review, abandoned, or failed-closed.
Restore AgentCore state to Recovering, Suspended, RollbackPending, or Completed based on durable evidence.
Prevent replanning from hiding unresolved effects.
Write RecoveryStarted and RecoveryCompleted events linked to run_id and step_id.
acceptance_criteria: A run interrupted after EffectPrepared is recoverable from persisted state.
Write effects without seal are classified for rollback or human review.
Read-only unresolved effects can be verified and sealed when safe.
Recovery never relies on asking the model what happened.
Recovery events are written to audit.
verification: Simulate crash after prepare, after observe, and after verification failure.
Inspect recovery report and audit events.
risk_notes: Recovery is the line between an agent runtime and a chat script; effect truth must be durable.
